item.description: Mimo 0.1.6 English - Refined the menu bar panel with per-profile pinned policy groups, inline expansion and profile switching. Added Dashboard and Remote Controller shortcuts, removed duplicate traffic charts and the power button, and unified action rows and the native window material. - Added instant switching between Simplified Chinese and English, plus a dashboard control to show or hide IP addresses. - Expanded Remote Controller column customization and added custom proxy-set names to connection details. - Replaced the system chart with a compact resource bar and added application memory alongside core metrics. - Fixed extra table-header borders, incorrect horizontal-scroller viewport binding and clipped detail scrollers; normalized the MIPS stack label. 简体中文 - 优化菜单栏面板：支持按配置置顶策略组、面板内展开和配置切换；新增仪表盘与远程控制器入口，移除重复流量图和电源按钮，统一操作行及原生窗口材质。 - 新增简体中文与英文即时切换，以及仪表盘 IP 地址显示开关。 - 扩展远程控制器的列自定义选项，连接详情显示自定义远程代理集名称。 - 使用紧凑资源条替代系统图表，并在内核指标旁显示应用内存。 - 修复列表表头多余边框、水平滚动条控制错误视口及连接详情滚动条裁切的问题，统一 MIPS 协议栈标签。

Mimo 0.1.5

English
- Ordinary app updates now reuse Enhanced Service authorization when the service code, security properties and signing identity are unchanged.
- Kept native signature, user identity, file permission and integrity checks.
- Unified policy group type names as select, url-test, fallback and load-balance in both languages, and removed decorative type-picker icons.
- Existing Enhanced Service installations require one administrator authorization to migrate to this mechanism when next used.

简体中文
- 优化增强服务授权流程：服务代码、安全属性和签名身份未变化时，普通应用更新复用已有授权。
- 保留原生签名、用户身份、文件权限和完整性校验。
- 策略组类型在中英文界面统一使用 select、url-test、fallback、load-balance，并移除类型菜单的装饰图标。
- 已安装的增强服务下次使用时仍需授权一次，以迁移到新的授权机制。

Mimo 0.1.4

English
- Added Simplified Chinese and English UI localization, following the system language.
- Localized the main app, menu bar, Remote Controller, dialogs, help and error messages.
- Improved English layouts and singular/plural forms for counts.
- Preserved saved profile and node names, configuration values and traffic history.

简体中文
- 新增简体中文和英文界面，默认跟随系统语言。
- 覆盖主应用、菜单栏、远程控制器、弹窗、帮助与错误提示。
- 优化英文布局和数量单复数显示。
- 保留已保存的配置与节点名称、配置值及流量历史。
